summaryZh: SIO-A Lab 利用声音理解海洋，研究信号处理、机器学习、波传播、海洋声学、海洋学与海洋生物学。研究结合海上采集声学数据、传播模型和反演计算。

evidence.quote: Welcome to the SIO-A Lab We are nerds working on signal processing, machine learning, wave propagation, ocean acoustics, oceanography and marine biology.
We all spend countless hours on the computer, crunching acoustic data, running propagation models or inversion codes.
